About.heroSubtitle: The journey of creating the world's finest bedding
About.storyPara1: Founded in 2010, Noiraé was born from a simple belief: that quality sleep begins with exceptional bedding. What started as a passion project in a small atelier has grown into a global destination for those who appreciate the finer things in life.
About.storyPara2: Our founder, inspired by travels through the silk roads of Asia and the cashmere valleys of Mongolia, set out to create a collection that would bring these luxurious materials to bedrooms around the world. Every piece in our collection tells a story of craftsmanship, sustainability, and timeless elegance.
About.valueQualityText: We source only the finest materials from trusted suppliers around the world. Each piece undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure it meets our exacting standards.
About.valueSustainabilityText: From ethical sourcing to eco-friendly packaging, we're committed to minimizing our environmental impact while supporting the communities we work with.
About.valueArtisanText: Every product is crafted by skilled artisans who have honed their craft over decades. Their expertise ensures that every stitch, every weave is perfect.
About.timeline2010Text: Noiraé was founded in a small atelier with a vision to create the world's finest bedding from natural luxury materials.
About.timeline2013Text: Launched our signature silk collection, featuring premium mulberry silk sourced directly from sustainable farms in China.
About.timeline2016Text: Introduced our revolutionary cashmere bedding line, bringing the softness of Mongolian cashmere to the bedroom.
About.timeline2020Text: Expanded our reach to serve customers in over 50 countries, bringing luxury bedding to homes worldwide.
About.timeline2024Text: Achieved carbon-neutral operations and launched our circular economy initiative for product recycling and reuse.
About.ctaText: Discover our collection of luxury bedding and transform your bedroom into a sanctuary of comfort.

Faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Faq.noResults: No questions found matching your search.
Faq.materialsQuestion: What materials are used in Noirae bedding?
Faq.materialsAnswer: Our bedding collections primarly feature ethically sourced mulberry silk and premium cashmere, known both for their exceptional softness, anti-regulating and natural properties. We also use a within-strain cotton for certain collections.
Faq.silkCareQuestion: How do I care for my silk bedding?
Faq.silkCareAnswer: Silk bedding should be hand washed in cold water with a gentle detergent or dry cleaned. Avoid direct sunlight when drying and never use bleach. For best results, iron on low heat while slightly damp.
Faq.shippingOptionsQuestion: What are your shipping options and times?
Faq.shippingOptionsAnswer: We offer standard shipping (5-7 business days) and express shipping (2-3 business days). All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Free standard shipping is available on orders over $200.
Faq.openReturnsQuestion: Do you offer returns for opened items?
Faq.openReturnsAnswer: Yes, we accept returns within 30 days of purchase, even if the packaging has been opened. Items must be in unused condition with all original tags attached. Please contact our customer service team to initiate a return.
Faq.returnPolicyQuestion: What is your return policy for opened items?
Faq.returnPolicyAnswer: We offer a 30-day return policy for opened items that are in unused condition. The product must be in its original state with tags attached. Return shipping is free for defective items, otherwise a $15 return shipping fee applies.
Faq.paymentMethodsQuestion: What payment methods do you accept?
Faq.paymentMethodsAnswer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.
Faq.modifyOrderQuestion: Can I modify or cancel my order?
Faq.modifyOrderAnswer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 2 hours of placement. Please contact our customer service team immediately if you need to make changes.
Faq.internationalShippingAnswer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping times vary by location, typically 7-14 business days. Customs fees and import duties are the responsibility of the customer.
Faq.cashmereCareQuestion: How do I care for cashmere bedding?
Faq.cashmereCareAnswer: Cashmere should be dry cleaned or hand washed in cool water with a cashmere-specific detergent. Lay flat to dry away from direct heat or sunlight. Store folded in a breathable bag with cedar or lavender to prevent moths.
Faq.hypoallergenicAnswer: Yes, our silk and cashmere products are naturally hypoallergenic and resistant to dust mites, mold, and mildew. They are ideal for people with sensitive skin or allergies.

ShippingReturns.intro: At Noirae, we are committed to providing a seamless and luxurious experience from the moment you browse our collections to the moment your order arrives at your doorstep. Below you will find detailed information about our shipping and return policies, designed to make your experience as smooth as our finest silk.
ShippingReturns.shippingMethodsBody: We offer complimentary standard shipping on all domestic orders over $150. For orders under $150, a flat rate of $10 applies. Express shipping is available for an additional fee calculated at checkout based on your location.
ShippingReturns.deliveryTimesBody: Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days. Please note that delivery times may vary during peak seasons or holidays. You will receive a tracking number via email once your order has shipped.
ShippingReturns.orderTrackingBody: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. You will receive an email confirmation when your order is placed, and another email with tracking information when your order ships. You can track your order anytime through the link provided in your shipping confirmation email.
ShippingReturns.returnProcessBody: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. To initiate a return, please visit our returns portal or contact customer service. A pre-paid shipping label will be provided for your convenience.
ShippingReturns.eligibilityBody: Items must be unused, unwashed, and in their original condition with all tags attached. We reserve the right to refuse returns that do not meet these conditions. Final sale items and personalized products are not eligible for return.
ShippingReturns.refundsBody: Refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days of receiving your return. The refund will be issued to your original payment method. Exchanges can be requested through our customer service team, subject to availability.
ShippingReturns.ctaText: Have more questions? Our customer service team is here to help.
